item.title: Trading in Dhaka's stock market decreased by 24 and a half percent
item.description: Today, Monday, shares were traded at Tk 921 crore, which was Tk 1,220 crore yesterday on Sunday.

item.title: New service of Trust Bank for Chattogram port
item.description: Trust Bank has launched a new revenue collection and payment automation service called 'Trustport Connect' with Chattogram Port Authority.

item.title: The wages of garment workers are increasing from Tk 4500 to Tk 6465
item.description: In the new wage structure for readymade garment workers, wages will increase by 36 to 43 percent across grades. Compared to the wage structure set in 2023, this increase is from 4,500 to Tk 6,465.

item.title: The story of building a multi-crore venture from a college student to a 200-employee industrial enterprise
item.description: Ayesha Siddika Kaya of Santhia Upazila, Pabna, is a unique example of how a college student can build a business worth crores of rupees in just seven and a half years by…

item.title: Bangladesh's Milestone in Global Cyber ​​Security: First CNA 'Night Squad'
item.description: A historic chapter has begun in Bangladesh's cyber security and technology sector. On November 17, 2026, Knight Squad Academy was officially recognized as the first CVE Numbering…

item.title: 15 years of Lotto in Bangladesh: New factory in Kapasia
item.description: Lotto Bangladesh celebrates its 15th anniversary. Inaugurated new factory in Kapasia.

item.title: Despite the intense competition in the European market, the export of shoes is a surprise
item.description: In the first three months of the current fiscal, footwear exports have grown more than ready-made garments. Purchase orders are increasing in the United States. Hope in the new market.

item.title: After the scandal, Jensen Huang made a fortune of Tk 6 lakh crore
item.description: Jensen Huang's wealth loss is equivalent to about two-thirds of Bangladesh's budget.

item.title: The basic salary of three army chiefs is 1 lakh 72 thousand, soldiers 21 thousand Tk 400
item.description: The Ministry of Defense on November 15 issued the Joint Force Guidelines for Pay and Allowances of Armed Forces personnel. The new salary will be available step by step. But it will be effective from July 1.

item.title: GDP growth will be 5.7% if reformed, World Bank report reveals
item.description: According to the World Bank's Bangladesh Public Finance Review 2026 report, subsidies need to be targeted more specifically at poor and vulnerable populations. It will be possible to ensure the protection of these families.

item.title: 3-4 thousand crores of rupees have been lost in the ongoing movement in the garment sector
item.description: BGBA press conference

item.title: Risk of cyber attack in banking sector using AI, SERT warns
item.description: SERT has warned banks and financial institutions of the country about the risk of cyber attacks on banks and financial institutions using artificial intelligence (AI).

item.title: Bangladeshi 'LetX' is trusted by researchers around the world to overcome the limitations of theses
item.description: In the final moments of writing a research paper or thesis, a researcher's greatest need is the opportunity to work seamlessly and immediately with fellow researchers.

item.title: From plastic waste to the European market: how a Bangladeshi entrepreneur built a 60-crore recycling business
item.description: Hamid Hasan Alvi, the founder of Polyeco Recycling Industries, was recently recognized as the 'Best Green SME Business Entrepreneur of the Year' at the 13th National SME Product Fair.

item.title: Suggestion to reduce the number of banks in the country
item.description: Dialogue of IBA Alumni

item.title: The governor wants 35 percent of the bank's total loans to the SME sector
item.description: The governor said that by 2027, 35 percent of the bank's loans should go to the SME sector. He also advised to limit investment in the corporate sector.

item.title: Ruhul, who left the engineering profession and became an agricultural entrepreneur, successfully built 550 bigha 'King Silage'
item.description: As the nation's dairy and cattle farmers struggle to meet production costs amid unbridled consumption of grain feed, corn silage is showing new hope as a cost-effective and nutritious alternative.

item.title: World class 'Lotus Silk' is being made from lotus stalks in Faridpur, export potential
item.description: The traditional 'Chapai Bill' or Padma Bill of Ronkail village in Kanaipur Union of Faridpur Sadar Upazila is not only an attraction for nature lovers and tourists, but has also opened up new possibilities for the rural economy. item.description: Chattogram port

item.title: 12 companies got new certificate, now there are 302 eco-friendly factories in Bangladesh
item.description: Adji Trims of Dhamrai, Dhaka has obtained the LEAD Platinum certificate by getting the maximum 97 points among the 12 organizations that have received the new certificate.

item.title: Special exit facility for settlement of defaulted loans, new instructions to banks
item.description: Interest waiver is available on one-time loan settlement. The approval of the bank's board of directors should be taken to provide this facility. The four conditions of the previous policy must be followed.

item.title: Don't get in trouble while filing income tax return, prepare 6 types of information in advance
item.description: Do not hide your income, expenses, assets, liabilities, donations and gifts while preparing your income tax return. Any omission of information may lead to complications in the future.

item.title: Anthropic is one of the most valuable companies in the world, the entrepreneurs are millionaires
item.description: Anthropic, maker of AI chatbot Claude, has made its stock market debut. After the start of trading in Nasdaq, the market value of the company stood at 1 lakh 76 thousand billion dollars.

item.title: 450 people will be employed in the new factory in Mongla EPZ with an investment of over Tk 100 crore
item.description: Blue Mangrove Packaging will set up a garment manufacturing plant in Mongla EPZ at an investment of $8.7 million. Employment will be 450 people.

item.title: Government's total debt is Tk 23.38 lakh crore: Finance Minister
item.description: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said that as of June 30, the total government debt of Bangladesh is about Tk 23.38 lakh crore. Today, Monday, he gave this information during the question and answer session in the National Parliament.

item.title: Despite the increase in bank accounts, women lag behind in loans
item.description: Such information has emerged in the report titled 'Financial Inclusion Report Bangladesh, 2025' of Bangladesh Bank. According to the report, women are lagging behind in getting loans as entrepreneurs.

item.title: If the salary is Tk 50 thousand, City Bank will give a loan of up to Tk 6 lakh, how to apply
item.description: The repayment period is 12 to 60 months or one to five years. That is, the borrower can choose the repayment term according to his ability and needs.

item.title: The central bank wants Tk 2700 crore to refund the money of customers of 9 financial institutions
item.description: On November 3, the Central Bank has sent a letter to the Ministry of Finance asking for money. Institutions for which money has been sought - International Leasing, Aviva Finance, FAS Finance, Fareast Finance, People's Leasing, Prime Finance, GSP Finance, BIFC and Premier Leasing.

item.title: The government wants to issue bonds in New York and London, the aim is to reduce bank debt
item.description: The government wants to raise funds through bonds and sukuk to reduce dependence on bank loans. There are plans to issue bonds in the international market in the next two to three months. For that, initiatives are being taken to expand capital and bond markets.
